paras_en: Hollywood film “The Big Short” was based on Michael Burry, a well‑known investor, who said last week that his biggest worry – that after Warren Buffett steps down his successor would be “older, not Buffett, and lack the patience to swing the best bat” – has already come true, and he now views Berkshire Hathaway as no longer an attractive investment.
The day after his comments, Berkshire just released a 2026 Q2 earnings report that was “numerically impressive but narratively subtle.”

According to the earnings slip Berkshire disclosed on Saturday (the 8th), its Q2 net profit attributable to shareholders was $25.67 billion, almost double the $12.37 billion a year earlier, driven mainly by a rebound in unrealized gains on equity investments. Excluding that item, operating profit was $12.98 billion, up 16.3% year‑over‑year, with manufacturing, services and retail contributing $4.47 billion – a 24% rise – while Geico weighed on insurance underwriting profit.
Buffett has repeatedly warned that “net profit is distorted by fair‑value fluctuations; operating profit is the true temperature gauge of the business.”

What really caught the market’s eye was that “the money started moving.” In Q2 this year Berkshire bought $23.5 billion of stock and sold $3.7 billion, marking the first net stock purchase in more than three years, and simultaneously repurchased 478 million Class A shares and over 8 million Class B shares for about $4.5 billion – a clear step‑up from the $2.34 billion in Q1, though still below analysts’ $5‑$11 billion expectations.

As of the end of June, Berkshire’s cash and U.S. Treasury holdings stood at $364.7 billion, down 4% quarter‑over‑quarter – the first decline in four years. In the same period the company also spent $6.8 billion to acquire homebuilder Taylor Morrison (closing in July, not reflected in Q2 results) and signed a private‑placement agreement for $10 billion of the $80 billion Google financing deal.
In January this year Buffett passed the 60‑year baton to Greg Abel, who officially became Berkshire’s CEO while Buffett remains chairman.

Burry’s criticism targets that very gap: whether Abel will exercise the same restraint Buffett showed by “holding back on buying.” Opponents argue that Q2 operating profit grew double‑digits, cash is flowing into buybacks and net stock purchases, and the top five holdings – Apple, American Express, Bank of America, Coca‑Cola and Alphabet – remain tightly tied to cash‑flow powerhouses.

Paul Lountzis, president of Lountzis Asset Management, said the private‑equity market is currently “very crazy” and the public market is somewhat irrational, making it “hard to demand that Abel execute massive deals right now,” and investors are still willing to give him time.

Berkshire’s stock rose only 4.28% in Q2, lagging the S&P 500’s 14.87% gain – Burry’s cool assessment and the market’s hesitation stem from the same issue: after the legend hands over the reins, the market no longer wants “the next Buffett,” but proof that Abel can deliver strong results even with $364.7 billion on the balance sheet.

items.title: 日月光投控7月營收738億元 年增43%飆單月新高
items.title_en: Jabil Circuit 7M Revenue Hits NT$73.8B, Up 43% YoY
paras: 封測龍頭日月光投控 (3711-TW)(ASX-US) 今 (10) 日公布 7 月營收 737.84 億元，月增 12.16%，年增 43.15%，累計前 7 月營收 4,385.09 億元，年增 25.13%；受惠先進封裝與傳統打線封裝雙雙熱絡，日月光投控 7 月營收首度突破 700 億元大關，一舉創下歷史新高。
觀察封測及材料業務營收，日月光投控受惠產能利用率持續攀升，加上漲價效應陸續發酵，7 月業績達 475.24 億元，月增 9.3%，年增 49.5%。
由於 AI 先進封裝需求持續強勁，日月光投控看好，今年 LEAP 先進封裝服務營收將優於原先 35 億美元目標，並預期在新增廠房與設備陸續到位後，2027 年 LEAP 營收可望較今年再翻倍。
為因應客戶強勁訂單，日月光投控今年資本支出預計衝破百億美元，達 105 億美元，較先前的 85 億美元，上調 23.5%，再度創下歷史新高，並預期明年同樣會維持高檔，以維持公司在先進封裝與先進測試的領先地位。
paras_en: Jabil Circuit (3711-TW) (JBL-US) today announced 7M revenue of NT$73.8 billion, up 12.16% MoM and 43.15% YoY, with a total of NT$438.5 billion in revenue for the first 7 months, up 25.13% YoY. The company's revenue exceeded NT$70 billion for the first time, setting a new historical high.
Jabil Circuit's revenue from testing and materials business reached NT$47.5 billion in 7M, up 9.3% MoM and 49.5% YoY, driven by increased utilization rates and price increases.

Due to strong demand for AI advanced packaging, Jabil Circuit is optimistic about its LEAP advanced packaging service revenue, which is expected to exceed the initial target of $3.5 billion and potentially double in 2027 after the addition of new facilities and equipment.

To meet strong customer orders, Jabil Circuit is expected to increase its capital expenditure to $10.5 billion this year, up 23.5% from the initial target of $8.5 billion, setting a new historical high. The company also expects to maintain a high level of capital expenditure next year to maintain its leading position in advanced packaging and testing.

items.title: 〈陸股盤後〉三大指數漲跌不一 滬指連5紅 重返3950點之上
items.title_en: Shanghai Composite Index Rises for 5th Day, Reaches 39,566.59
paras: 中國 A 股三大指數今 (10) 日收盤表現錯綜，上證指數(SSEC) 站回 3950 點大關且連 5 日收紅，創業板指則走跌，因投資人正消化最新通膨數據，並尋找中國政策前景線索。
滬指今日收漲 0.67% 至 3966.59 點，深證成指 (SZI) 收紅 0.04% 至 14316.96 點，創業板指收低 0.73% 至 3537.21 點，滬深兩市成交額人民幣 2.52 兆元，較上一個交易日量縮 1413 億元。

大盤方面，有色金屬族群走高，貴金屬、鎢礦方向領漲，華缽礦業、招金黃金漲停、翔鷺鎢業出現 4 個交易日來第 2 根漲停板；醫藥股反覆活躍，百花醫藥連 5 天漲停，哈三聯 5 個交易日來 3 度漲停作收、畢得醫藥、皓宸醫療、貝瑞基因、大東方、百花醫藥、美年健康等多股漲停；電網設備概念表現活躍，中電鑫龍、京泉華、三變科技漲停；AI 應用概念股盤中拉升，石基資訊、榕基軟體漲停；影視族群午後集體走強，儒意電影、北京文化漲停；軍工類股全天領漲大盤，長城軍工、宏都航空漲停。
下跌族群方面，算力硬體產業鏈調整。通訊和電子族群領跌兩市，連創光電、武漢凡谷等跌停或跌超 10%，鍇威特、長盈通、光迅科技、通宇通訊、迅捷興等跌超 7%；電腦族群跌幅亦居前，盈建科、朗科科技等跌超 9%，恆銀科技、品茗科技、開網科技等跌超 5%；機械設備低迷，泰金新能跌超 8%，燕麥科技、東威科技等跌超 5%，江鎢裝備、華興源創、聯訊儀器等跌超 2%。
消息面上，根據週日 (9 日) 公布的官方數據，中國通膨數據顯示價格壓力持續偏弱，7 月生產者物價 (PPI) 放緩幅度超預期，降至三個月最低，消費者物價指數 (CPI) 亦降溫。野村證券預期北京將更倚重財政手段穩增長，而非貨幣寬鬆，且中國出口韌性也可能降低大規模貨幣刺激的必要性。
根據 Wind 統計數據，滬深兩市及北交所共 4066 檔股票上漲，1386 檔下跌，平盤 80 檔。另據大智慧 VIP，滬深北三市共 138 檔股票漲幅在 9% 以上，13 檔股票跌幅在 9% 以上。

華泰證券表示，上週 A 股溫和放量反彈，風險偏好邊際修復，超跌反彈成為主要交易線索，小型股彈性顯著強於大盤。超跌反彈仍有演繹空間，重點在於創業板指。節奏上，8 月中下旬的半年報密集期將是檢驗反彈成色的窗口。配置上，錨定中報均衡配置。AI 硬體超跌反彈尚可參與，但公募籌碼未出清恐限制反彈幅度，必須控制部位。首選通訊設備，其他的超跌品種中，建議專注於能源金屬、小金屬。7 月相對抗跌品種中，繼續關注性價比尚可的非銀和 CXO 龍頭。中期來看，性價比出海鏈及必需消費處於增配窗口。紅利底倉繼續持有，結構上，重點配置銀行與交運。

中國銀河證券指出，8 月 A 股正從「預期博弈」轉向「現實驗證」，圍繞業績、政策、外圍風險三大線索展開。一是業績驗證。 8 月中下旬是 A 股半年報揭露最密集期間，市場可望圍繞業績預期驗證展開定價。二是政策驗證。7 月政治局會議對今年下半年中國經濟工作做出部署，後續進入政策細則推出與執行驗證階段。三是外圍風險驗證，聯準會 (Fed) 政策路徑仍是全球市場關注焦點。短期來看，結構性行情預計仍是主線，三大驗證線索將逐步明朗，策略上保持耐心與均衡，以績效確定性為矛、以防禦性資產為盾。
浙商證券建議，建議中期部位繼續持有、等待中期反彈逐步到位，短期部位可以在指數「進二退一」的「退一」時逢低參與，但切記避免在短期連續反彈的「進二」時追高。產業方面，目前已逐步走出的板塊有第一梯隊的證券、創新藥、恆生科技，以及第二梯隊的傳媒、電腦、有色金屬等板塊可以中期視角逢低關注、作為科技外的再平衡備選對象。
paras_en: The Shanghai Composite Index (SSEC) rose 0.67% to 39,566.59 today, marking its fifth consecutive day of gains. The index has broken through the 39,500-point level.

The Shenzhen Component Index (SZI) rose 0.04% to 14,316.96, while the ChiNext Index fell 0.73% to 3,537.21. The combined trading volume of the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges was 2.52 trillion yuan, down 141.3 billion yuan from the previous trading day.

The large-cap sector saw significant gains, with precious metals and molybdenum leading the charge. Shares of Wah Kwong Mining, Zijin Mining, and Xiangji Molybdenum rose to their daily limits, while shares of Huabao Pharmaceutical, Hualan Biotechnology, and other companies also rose to their daily limits.

The decline in the sector was led by the algorithmic hardware industry chain adjustment. The communication and electronics sector led the decline in both cities, with shares of Linkong Optoelectronics, Wuhan Vanke, and other companies falling to their daily limits or falling by more than 10%.

According to data released on Sunday, China's inflation data showed that price pressure remained weak, with the producer price index (PPI) slowing more than expected, falling to its lowest level in three months, and the consumer price index (CPI) also cooling down.

According to Wind data, a total of 4,066 stocks on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges rose, while 1,386 stocks fell, and 80 stocks remained unchanged. According to data from Zhongyuan VIP, a total of 138 stocks on the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Northbound stock exchanges rose by more than 9%, while 13 stocks fell by more than 9%.

Huatai Securities said that last week's A-share market saw a mild rebound, with risk appetite marginally repaired, and over-sold rebound becoming the main trading signal. Small-cap stocks showed significant flexibility compared to the large-cap market. The over-sold rebound still has room for interpretation, with a focus on the ChiNext Index.

China Galaxy Securities pointed out that the A-share market is transitioning from 'expectation game' to 'verification game' in August, with three major signals - earnings, policies, and external risks - taking center stage. First, earnings verification. August 15-20 is the most concentrated period for A-share semi-annual reports, and the market will focus on verifying earnings expectations.

Zhejiang Securities recommended that investors continue to hold long-term positions and wait for the mid-term rebound to take shape. In the short term, investors can participate in the market when the index is in the 'two steps forward, one step back' pattern, but avoid chasing the market when it is in a continuous rebound pattern.

items.title: 五角大廈要求國防巨頭加速生產以補充庫存
items.title_en: Pentagon Urges Defense Giants to Accelerate Production to Address Stockpile Shortages
paras: 隨著與伊朗的衝突持續加劇，美國五角大廈正向國內主要國防承包商施壓，要求其縮短武器開發周期並大幅擴大產能，以應對軍火庫存日益枯竭的壓力。
美國國防部副部長 Steve Feinberg 於 8 月 5 日致函波音 (BA-US)、洛克希德馬丁 (LMT-US) 及 RTX Corp (RTC-US) 等大廠，明確表示「長達數年的開發周期已不可接受」，軍方必須立即加速計畫時程。
此次加速生產的要求主要涵蓋廣域監控設備、防空感測器、飛彈攔截器及飛彈追蹤系統。
據報導，美軍在對抗伊朗及其代理人的行動中，因頻繁攔截攻擊美國基地與盟友的無人機與飛彈，導致彈藥儲備面臨嚴峻挑戰。專家指出，美軍已在相關衝突中消耗至少一半的「愛國者」飛彈庫存，這不僅影響自身戰備，也迫使美國在支援烏克蘭等盟友的軍援分配上做出艱難選擇。
除了應對當前戰場需求，Feinberg 在信中也強調了長期戰略項目的重要性，包括衛星通訊、次世代防空系統及洛克希德馬丁的「次世代攔截器」(Next Generation Interceptor)，後者旨在汰換舊型組件以強化本土防禦跨洲際彈道飛彈的能力。
其他被點名的優先項目還包括 RTX 的海軍 AN/SPY-6 雷達、Leidos 的長程監控網路，以及波音的 T-7A 教練機等。
儘管總統川普公開否認美國彈藥短缺，並宣稱擁有「巨量」儲備，但他也坦承部分系統的供應「稍微吃緊」，正每日補給中。
為了支撐龐大的產能需求，五角大廈正尋求 182 億美元的追加戰爭資金，並要求承包商於 8 月底前提交具體的加速交付計畫，說明如何透過增加人力與擴建設施來支持「更高容量且持續的訂單」。
paras_en: As tensions with Iran continue to escalate, the Pentagon is pressuring its top defense contractors to shorten development timelines and significantly increase production capacity to address growing pressure on dwindling stockpiles.

On August 5, Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg wrote to Boeing (BA-US), Lockheed Martin (LMT-US), and RTX Corp (RTC-US) and other major manufacturers, stating that "development timelines of several years are unacceptable" and that the military must immediately accelerate project timelines.
The accelerated production request primarily covers wide-area surveillance systems, air defense sensors, missile interceptors, and missile tracking systems.

According to reports, the US military has consumed at least half of its "Patriot" missile stockpile in its actions against Iran and its proxies, leaving ammunition reserves facing a severe challenge. Experts note that this has not only affected US military readiness but has also forced the US to make difficult decisions in allocating military aid to allies such as Ukraine.

In addition to addressing current battlefield needs, Feinberg emphasized the importance of long-term strategic projects, including satellite communications, next-generation air defense systems, and Lockheed Martin's "Next Generation Interceptor," which aims to replace old components to enhance the ability to defend against intercontinental ballistic missiles.
Other priority projects mentioned include RTX's Navy AN/SPY-6 radar, Leidos' long-range monitoring network, and Boeing's T-7A trainer.

Despite President Trump publicly denying US ammunition shortages and claiming to have "vast" reserves, he also acknowledged that some systems' supplies are "a bit tight" and are being replenished daily.

To support the massive production demands, the Pentagon is seeking an additional $182 billion in war funding and is requiring contractors to submit specific accelerated delivery plans by the end of August, outlining how they will support "higher capacity and sustained orders" through increased personnel and expanded facilities.

items.title: OpenAI「GPT-6」Astra傳8月登場！10兆參數、代號「Doug」模型年底再戰
items.title_en: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Expected to Launch in August, 10 Trillion Parameters, Codenamed 'Doug' Model to Debut by Year-End
paras: 社群平台 X 近日流傳一系列關於 OpenAI 下一代模型的消息。儘管公司近期才因故緊急暫停過該模型的推出計畫，但爆料指出，代號「Astra」的新模型，外界普遍推測即為「GPT-6」，可能在本月內發布。
截至目前，OpenAI 官方尚未證實任何相關細節，這些消息均來自社群帳號與業界觀察者的推測與二手訊息。
爆料帳號「ChrisGPT」宣稱，Astra 的參數規模可能達到約十兆，若屬實，將是外界普遍估算 GPT-4（約 1.8 兆參數）的五倍以上。
消息也連結到 OpenAI 總裁 Greg Brockman 近期在 X 上轉發的一則貼文，內容提及 GPT-4 的訓練工作是在四年前的 8 月 8 日完成，這個時間點的巧合，被部分網友解讀為 GPT-6 可能選在相近檔期發布的訊號。
若參數規模真如傳言大幅躍升，業界普遍認為新模型在邏輯推理與泛化能力上理應會有顯著提升，但目前並無獨立可信來源證實具體數字，一切仍停留在猜測階段。
除了 Astra，社群消息還指向另一個代號「Doug」的專案，據稱規模將遠超今年稍早發布的 Fable 5，且並非 GPT-6 本身，而是預計最快在 11 月前推出的獨立訓練成果。
研究機構 SemiAnalysis 此前也曾提及這個代號，市場分析人士 Pankaj Kumar 則推測，「Doug」很可能採用輝達 (NVDA-US) 尚未全面量產的次世代 Vera Rubin 晶片進行訓練。
這類傳聞若屬實，代表 OpenAI 正打算在下半年連續推出兩款重量級模型：先以 Astra 搶佔 8 月的市場聲量，再於年底以「Doug」衝擊技術指標，試圖鞏固業界領先地位。
但同樣地，這些細節目前僅止於業界傳聞，尚待官方證實。
部分評論指出，這一連串傳聞背後隱含一個更值得關注的產業現象：自 2024 年 5 月 GPT-4o 發布以來，OpenAI 已逾兩年未完成新一代尖端模型的全規模預訓練。
外界普遍認為，包括 o1、o3 到 GPT-5 系列在內的更新，多半是建立在 GPT-4o 既有基礎上進行後訓練與強化學習，而非從零打造新的模型底座。
也有消息稱，先前部分內部專案曾因表現未達預期而遭降級處理，但公司內部並未放棄推進大規模預訓練的方向；直到 Google(GOOGL-US) 去年底推出 Gemini 3 後，才促使 OpenAI 加速換代決心，並衍生出代號「Garlic」的驗證性專案，以及規模更大的「Doug」。
若消息屬實，這也呼應了業界長期爭論的「擴展定律（Scaling Law）是否已經失效」議題。
不過，SemiAnalysis 認為，只要運算資源與資料量持續擴大，模型效能仍有機會如預期般提升。
就在這波傳聞延燒之際，Google 也出現重大人事震盪。當地時間 8 月 5 日，任職 27 年的首席科學家 Jeff Dean 據報與三名核心研究員一同離職創業。
同一天，Google DeepMind 共同創辦人、諾貝爾獎得主哈薩比斯（Demis Hassabis）也宣布卸下執行長職務，轉任董事長。受此消息影響，母公司 Alphabet 股價當日一度下跌逾 4%。
這起人事變動被部分觀察者視為指標性事件，象徵原本被視為「三強鼎立」的生成式 AI 競賽格局，如今實質上僅剩 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 兩大陣營持續正面交鋒。
面對 Astra 可能來勢洶洶，市場也傳出 Anthropic 正籌劃在 8 月推出「Fable 5.1」，定價比照現行的 Fable 5，被視為直接對標 Astra 的策略性回應。
有觀察意見認為，Anthropic 稍早發布 Opus 5 時刻意保留部分技術實力，可能就是為了替 Fable 5.1 預留後手，一旦 OpenAI 新模型亮相，便能迅速跟進反制。
不過，這類「田忌賽馬」式的產品布局說法，同樣僅為市場推測，Anthropic 官方尚未對外證實相關發布計畫或時程。
paras_en: A series of rumors about OpenAI's next-generation model has been circulating on social media platforms. Although the company recently suspended the release plan for the model due to unforeseen circumstances, insiders claim that the codenamed 'Astra' model, widely speculated to be 'GPT-6', may be released as early as this month.
As of now, OpenAI has not officially confirmed any details, and these rumors come from social media accounts and industry observers' speculations and second-hand information.
The 'ChrisGPT' account claims that Astra's parameter scale may reach around 10 trillion, which would be more than five times the parameter scale of GPT-4 (approximately 1.8 trillion parameters).

The rumors are also linked to OpenAI CEO Greg Brockman's recent post on X, which mentions that GPT-4's training work was completed on August 8, 2023. This coincidence has been interpreted by some netizens as a signal that GPT-6 may be released around the same time.

If the parameter scale is indeed significantly increased, the industry generally believes that the new model should have a significant improvement in logical reasoning and generalization capabilities. However, there is currently no independent, reliable source to confirm the specific numbers, and everything remains in the speculation stage.

In addition to Astra, social media rumors also point to another codenamed 'Doug' project, which is said to be much larger than the recently released Fable 5 and is not GPT-6 itself, but rather an independent training result expected to be released as early as November.

Research institution SemiAnalysis has previously mentioned this codename, and market analyst Pankaj Kumar speculates that 'Doug' may use NVIDIA's (NVDA-US) next-generation Vera Rubin chip, which has not yet been fully mass-produced, for training.

If these rumors are true, it would mean that OpenAI is planning to release two heavyweight models in the second half of the year: first, Astra will grab market attention in August, and then 'Doug' will make a splash in December, aiming to solidify its leading position in the industry.
However, these details are currently only industry rumors and await official confirmation.

Some commentators point out that behind these rumors lies a more significant industry phenomenon: since GPT-4 was released in May 2024, OpenAI has been over two years without completing the full-scale pre-training of a new generation of advanced models.

The industry generally believes that updates, including o1, o3, and GPT-5, are mostly built on the existing foundation of GPT-4 and are subject to further training and reinforcement learning, rather than creating a new model base from scratch.

There are also rumors that some internal projects were downgraded due to underperformance, but the company has not given up on pushing forward with large-scale pre-training. It was not until Google (GOOGL-US) released Gemini 3 at the end of last year that OpenAI accelerated its upgrade plans and spawned the verification project codenamed 'Garlic' and the larger 'Doug'.
If the rumors are true, this would also echo the long-debated 'Scaling Law' issue in the industry.
However, SemiAnalysis believes that as long as computational resources and data volume continue to expand, model performance may still improve as expected.

Just as these rumors are raging, Google has experienced a significant personnel shake-up. On August 5, local time, Chief Scientist Jeff Dean, who has been with the company for 27 years, reportedly left with three core researchers to start a new company.

On the same day, Google DeepMind co-founder and Nobel laureate Demis Hassabis announced his resignation as CEO and took over as chairman. The news caused Alphabet's stock price to drop by over 4% on the same day.

This personnel change has been seen by some observers as a landmark event, symbolizing the fact that the originally perceived 'three-strong' generative AI competition landscape has now effectively narrowed down to OpenAI and Anthropic, with the two giants facing off against each other.

In the face of Astra's possible arrival, the market has also heard that Anthropic is planning to release 'Fable 5.1' in August, priced similarly to the current Fable 5, which is seen as a strategic response to directly target Astra.

Some observers believe that Anthropic deliberately reserved some technical capabilities when releasing Opus 5 earlier, which may be a reserve for Fable 5.1, allowing them to quickly follow up and counterattack once OpenAI's new model is released.
However, this 'Tianji racing horses' style product layout is also just market speculation, and Anthropic has not officially confirmed any release plans or schedules.

items.title: 黃仁勳罕見開口挺AI開源！一封公開信炸出矽谷「開源vs閉源」兩大陣營博弈
items.title_en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Rarely Speaks Out in Support of AI Open-Source, Sparking a Valley-Wide Debate on Open-Source vs Closed-Source
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳罕見聲援「開放權重」AI 模型，短短數天便吸引 70 多家企業與 AI 業界人士聯署，讓開放與封閉模型兩大陣營正式浮上檯面。這場看似技術路線之爭，背後其實牽動晶片、雲端、模型與 AI 應用的利益重新分配。
一向低調、鮮少在社群媒體上表態的黃仁勳，日前罕見地在 X 上發出他個人的第一則貼文，內容直接聲援一封題為《開放權重與美國 AI 領導力》（Open Weights and American AI Leadership）的聯署公開信。
這封信在短短數天內，聯署企業數量便從最初的 25 家暴增至 70 餘家，累積閱讀量突破 6000 萬次，也讓外界首次清楚看見，矽谷 AI 產業在「開放模型」與「封閉模型」兩條路線上，已形成壁壘分明的兩大陣營。
這封公開信的訴求相當直接：呼籲業界共同支持「開放權重」模型的發展，並反對監管單位對開源 AI 模型採取一刀切式的限制。
分析指出，這表面上看似只是一次產業倡議，但實際上內容直指幾個關鍵議題，包括防止新創企業被單一模型供應商綁定、將競爭從模型層擴大到雲端與晶片層、主張技術透明度有助於安全治理，以及為「知識蒸餾」（利用大型模型的輸出訓練較小模型）技術辯護，強調這是研究上行之有年的正當做法，不應被視為侵權或竊取。
信中傳達的核心立場，可以歸納為一句話：監管機構不應該為了防範尚未發生的風險，而限制開放權重這條技術路線的發展空間。
微軟 (MSFT-US) 執行長納德拉（Satya Nadella）、特斯拉 (TSLA-US) 執行長馬斯克、圖靈獎得主楊立昆（Yann LeCun），以及 AI 學者吳恩達（Andrew Ng）等重量級人物皆列名聲援，陣容堪稱近年 AI 圈規模最大的一次集體表態。

各懷盤算：誰在支持開源，為了什麼

觀察這份聯署名單背後的企業組成，不難發現這其實是一場關於 AI 產業鏈利潤分配的角力，各方支持開源都有各自的商業考量。
晶片與硬體廠商如輝達、戴爾科技 (DELL-US) ，最在意的是算力需求能否持續擴張。當愈來愈多企業選擇自行部署與微調開放權重模型，硬體採購與雲端算力的需求也會隨之水漲船高，這正是輝達力挺開源的根本動機。
微軟、Palantir(PLTR-US) 等雲端服務與企業軟體業者，則希望藉由開放權重模型豐富自家雲端平台的產品線，讓企業客戶不必被單一 API 供應商綁定，進而把客戶留在自己的雲端與訂閱服務生態中。
以 Meta(META-US) 為首的開源陣營與生態基礎設施業者，則是希望透過開放模型（如 Llama 系列）掌握技術標準的主導權；Mistral、Hugging Face 等新創公司也藉此爭取原本被閉源巨頭壟斷的企業客戶。
而創投圈如 a16z、YC 等機構，則擔心若底層模型長期被少數閉源公司把持，應用層新創的獲利空間將被大幅壓縮，因此力挺開放權重，以確保新創公司在成本與商業模式上仍有議價空間。

Anthropic 缺席聯署 立場鮮明成為焦點

值得注意的是，在這波近乎「集體站隊」的聲勢中，Anthropic 的缺席格外顯眼。
作為閉源陣營的代表性企業，Anthropic 不僅未加入聯署，其員工 Julian 更在 X 上公開對開源陣營表達不以為然的態度，直接引發吳恩達的回應。
吳恩達表示，任何公司都有權利選擇不公開自己的程式碼，但沒有立場去阻止其他人選擇開源。
外界普遍認為，Anthropic 對開放權重的保留態度，與其商業模式高度相關。
該公司的營收與估值，很大程度建立在模型能力的稀缺性之上。一旦市場上出現足以替代的開源模型，其 API 訂價的溢價空間與資本市場對其成長性的想像，都可能受到衝擊。而監管政策未來如何拿捏，也仍是開源陣營必須持續面對的變數。

模型走向「基礎設施化」，應用層成新戰場

分析稱，隨著開源模型的性能持續逼近甚至部分超越閉源模型，業界觀察普遍認為，底層大型語言模型正逐漸「基礎設施化」，也就是逐漸成為低成本、高普及的公共資源，單靠堆疊參數規模已難以構成長期競爭優勢。
在這樣的趨勢下，產業利潤可能會朝兩端集中：一端是輝達等掌握運算基礎設施的硬體廠商；另一端則是能將 AI 技術與企業真實資料、業務流程及智慧代理（Agent）深度結合的應用層公司。
與此同時，企業客戶對資料主權與技術安全性的重視程度提高，也讓「參數規模較小、可私有化部署、性能貼近實際需求」的垂直領域模型，加上端側運算裝置（如 AI PC、AI 手機）的普及，被部分業界人士視為下一階段較具確定性的商業化方向。
這場開放與封閉路線之爭，短期內恐怕難有定論。但對整個 AI 產業而言，這場公開的路線辯論，某種程度上也標誌著這個產業正式告別野蠻生長的早期階段，進入規則與利益重新分配的新局面。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang has rarely spoken out in support of open-source AI models, but his recent endorsement has sparked a valley-wide debate on open-source vs closed-source.
Huang, who is usually low-key and rarely speaks out on social media, recently posted a rare message on X in support of an open letter titled 'Open Weights and American AI Leadership'.

The open letter, which has gained over 60 million reads in a short span of time, has seen the number of signatories jump from 25 to over 70, making it clear that the AI industry in Silicon Valley has formed two distinct camps: open-source and closed-source.

The open letter's demands are straightforward: it calls on the industry to support the development of open-source models and opposes regulatory bodies from imposing blanket restrictions on open-source AI models.

Analysts point out that this seemingly technical debate actually touches on several key issues, including preventing startups from being locked into a single model provider, expanding competition from the model layer to the cloud and chip layers, advocating for transparency in technology to improve governance, and defending the use of 'knowledge distillation' (training smaller models using the output of large models) as a legitimate research practice.
The core stance of the open letter can be summed up in one sentence: regulatory bodies should not restrict the development of open-source models to prevent potential risks that have not yet occurred.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) CEO Satya Nadella, Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk, Turing Award winner Yann LeCun, and AI expert Andrew Ng, among others, have signed the open letter, making it one of the largest collective statements in the AI community in recent years.
The signatories' motivations are varied, with each having their own commercial considerations.
Chip and hardware manufacturers like NVIDIA and Dell (DELL-US) are concerned about whether the demand for computing power will continue to grow.

Microsoft, Palantir (PLTR-US), and other cloud service and enterprise software providers hope to enrich their cloud platforms with open-source models, allowing customers to avoid being locked into a single API provider and keeping customers within their cloud and subscription services ecosystem.

The open-source camp, led by Meta (META-US), hopes to control the standards of technology through open models (such as the Llama series); startups like Mistral and Hugging Face also seek to win over customers from closed-source giants.

Venture capital firms like a16z and YC are concerned that if the underlying models are controlled by a few closed-source companies, the profit space for application-layer startups will be significantly compressed, so they support open-source to ensure that startups have room for negotiation on costs and business models.
Anthropic's absence from the open letter has become a focal point, with its employees expressing skepticism about the open-source camp.
Andrew Ng responded that any company has the right to choose not to open-source its code, but it has no right to prevent others from doing so.
The external community believes that Anthropic's cautious attitude towards open-source is closely related to its business model, which relies heavily on the scarcity of model capabilities.

Anthropic's revenue and valuation are largely based on the scarcity of model capabilities. If open-source models appear in the market, the API pricing premium and the capital market's imagination of its growth potential may be affected.
The regulatory policy in the future will also be a variable that the open-source camp must continue to face.

As open-source models continue to approach and even surpass closed-source models in performance, the industry has come to a consensus that large language models are gradually 'infrastructure-izing', becoming low-cost and widely available public resources, and relying solely on parameter scale is no longer a long-term competitive advantage.

In this trend, industry profits may concentrate at both ends: one end is held by chip manufacturers like NVIDIA, and the other end is held by companies that can deeply integrate AI technology with enterprise real data, business processes, and intelligent agents.

At the same time, the importance of data sovereignty and technical security for enterprise customers has increased, making vertical domain models with smaller parameters, private deployment, and performance close to actual needs, as well as edge computing devices (such as AI PCs and AI phones), a more certain commercial direction in the next stage.

This open-source vs closed-source debate may not have a clear conclusion in the short term, but it marks the beginning of the AI industry's transition from a wild-growth early stage to a stage with rules and interest redistribution.

items.title: 估值回歸健康水位！高盛：中國AI無泡沫 三大細分領域最具投資價值
items.title_en: Valuation Returns to Healthy Levels! Goldman Sachs: China AI Has No Bubble, Three Sub-Fields Most Valuable for Investment
paras: 近來，全球 AI 類股因基建投資可持續性與估值過高疑慮震盪加劇，半導體等 AI 概念股自高點大幅回調，但高盛首席中國股票策略師劉勁津最新表態，中國 AI 族群並不存在整體性泡沫，近期修正反令估值回歸健康水平，並看好三大細分領域投資機會。
劉勁津在接受媒體採訪時指出，中國 AI 相關股票總市值尚未充分反映這項技術對整體經濟的潛在紅利。
他坦言，今年 6 月 A 股確實出現局部過熱。科創板與創業板部分 AI 硬體公司估值一度觸及五年高點，但隨後股價回落與獲利預期調整，目前已重新達成動態平衡，估值步入「合理健康」區間。
數據顯示，中國 AI 企業目前約佔全球 AI 類股總市值的 11%，但海外資金 AI 投資組合中配置到中國 AI 類股的部位僅約 1%。
高盛據此判斷，外資對中國 AI 類股的低配程度極高，意味著後續存在顯著的加碼空間與估值修復潛力。
高盛還明確點名三大最具投資價值的 AI 細分領域：首先是電力供應鏈，AI 資料中心能耗激增將持續推高電力設備與能源管理需求；其次是硬體基礎設施，涵蓋算力晶片、伺服器、光模塊及液冷散熱等核心環節；第三是物理 AI，即 AI 與機器人、自動化設備的深度融合，這被視為繼大模型之後的下一個產業落地爆發點。
市場分析認為，儘管短期受全球風險偏好波動影響，但中國 AI 產業鏈在應用場景、工程化能力與製造配套上的優勢依然明確。高盛「低配」判斷與「三大賽道」指引，為市場提供了重要的逆向佈局參考。隨著今年下半年獲利驗證期到來，具備真實業績兌現能力的標的有望率先走出估值窪地。
paras_en: Recently, global AI-related stocks have been shaken by concerns over sustainable investment and overvaluation, with semiconductor and AI-concept stocks experiencing a sharp decline from their highs. However, Goldman Sachs' chief China equity strategist, Liu Jingjin, has stated that China's AI sector does not have a systemic bubble, and the recent correction has brought valuations back to a healthy level, with a positive outlook for investment opportunities in three sub-fields.
Liu Jingjin pointed out in an interview that the total market value of China's AI-related stocks has not yet fully reflected the potential benefits of this technology on the overall economy.

He admitted that there was a local overheating in the A-share market in June this year. Some AI hardware companies on the Science and Technology Innovation Board and the Growth Enterprise Board had their valuations reach a five-year high, but the stock prices subsequently fell and earnings expectations were adjusted, and the valuations have now returned to a dynamic balance, entering the 'reasonable and healthy' zone.

Data shows that China's AI companies currently account for about 11% of the total market value of global AI-related stocks, but overseas funds have only allocated about 1% of their AI investment portfolios to China's AI-related stocks.

Goldman Sachs believes that the low allocation of foreign capital to China's AI-related stocks is extremely high, indicating that there is a significant potential for subsequent additions and valuation repairs.

Goldman Sachs has also identified three sub-fields with the most investment value: first, the power supply chain, where AI data centers will continue to drive up demand for power equipment and energy management; second, hardware infrastructure, covering core components such as computing chips, servers, optical modules, and liquid cooling heat dissipation; third, physical AI, which refers to the deep integration of AI and robotics, automation equipment, and is seen as the next industry landing explosion point after large models.

Market analysis believes that although the short-term is affected by the fluctuation of global risk preferences, China's AI industry chain still has clear advantages in application scenarios, engineering capabilities, and manufacturing support. Goldman Sachs' 'low allocation' judgment and 'three-track' guidance provide important references for market reverse layout. As the second-half earnings verification period approaches, companies with real performance realization capabilities are expected to be the first to emerge from the valuation trough.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會升息預期降溫 升值5.7分收32.231元
items.title_en: TWD Rises 5.7 Points to Close at 32.231 as Fed Rate Hike Expectations Cool
paras: 新台幣今 (10) 日維持偏強走勢，全日均處升值，終場收在 32.231 元，升值 5.7 分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值 12.23 億美元，以實質拋補需求為交投主軸。
新台幣今日以 32.26 元、升值 2.8 分開出後，最高來到 32.201 元，全日高低價差僅 6.9 分。
觀察主要亞幣，泰銖升約 0.2%，新台幣收升 0.18%，人民幣微升 0.05%，星元小貶 0.05% 左右，美元指數則小幅反彈 0.1%，而日元則重挫 0.4%，韓元更是重挫超過 0.7%。
元大投顧說明，由於美國 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，聯準會 9 月升息機率驟降，使風險偏好提升，市場關注 9 月 15 日至 16 日聯準會舉行會議；而台股密集聚焦季報和營收數字，個股波動大。
國泰證期研究部也指出，美國 7 月非農減少 2.3 萬人，遠遜預期，且前兩月合計下修 10.3 萬人，在薪資和勞參率同步降溫下，顯示就業動能明顯轉弱，市場因而下修 9 月升息預期，美債殖利率回落。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar maintained its strong momentum today, rising throughout the day and closing at 32.231, up 5.7 points. The total trading value of the Taipei Foreign Exchange Market was $1.223 billion, with actual demand for currency exchange being the main driver of trading.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.26, up 2.8 points, and rose to a high of 32.201 during the day, with a daily high-low price difference of only 6.9 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the Thai baht rose about 0.2%, the New Taiwan dollar rose 0.18%, the Chinese yuan rose slightly by 0.05%, the Singapore dollar fell about 0.05%, the US dollar index rebounded slightly by 0.1%, while the Japanese yen plummeted 0.4% and the Korean won fell more than 0.7%.

According to Yuanta Investment Consulting, due to the unexpected decrease in US non-farm employment in July, the probability of a Fed rate hike in September plummeted, leading to an increase in risk appetite. The market is now focusing on the Fed meeting on September 15-16, while the Taiwanese stock market is focused on quarterly reports and revenue figures, resulting in large fluctuations in individual stocks.

The research department of Cathay Futures also pointed out that the decrease of 23,000 in US non-farm employment in July was far below expectations, and the total revision for the previous two months was 103,000. With the decline in wages and labor participation rate, the employment momentum has clearly weakened, leading the market to lower its expectations for a September rate hike, causing US bond yields to fall.

items.title: 日本央行釋鷹派信號：通膨風險升溫 升息步伐或快於市場預期
items.title_en: Bank of Japan Signals Hawkish Stance: Inflation Risks Rise, Rate Hikes May Outpace Market Expectations
paras: 根據日本央行公布的 7 月政策會議意見摘要，日銀內部對通膨升溫風險的關注顯著提升。一名委員指出，鑑於核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 已接近 2% 的目標，且物價上行風險較以往更高，日銀未來的升息步調可能會比市場預期的更快。
在該次會議中，日銀將政策利率維持在 1%，但明確釋放了 9 月可能進一步升息的訊號。
日銀委員呼籲應展現防止通膨向上偏離的決心，並主張採取更靈活的方法，根據海外金融環境的變化討論升息規模，而非固守特定的升息節奏。目前，政策焦點已從「將通膨提升至 2%」轉向「避免通膨進一步向上偏離」。
日元走勢是推動升息預期的關鍵因素。日元兌美元匯率上月跌至 40 年低點，加劇了進口型通膨的疑慮。市場參與者已開始反映提前升息的可能性，隔夜掉期交易顯示，9 月升息的機率約為三分之二，而 10 月前升息的機率則高達 96%。
日銀總裁植田和男在會後記者會中同樣展現鷹派色調，強調價格前景存在較大的上行風險。有委員認為，儘管目前難以精確判定「中性利率」(即既不刺激也不冷卻經濟的利率水準，日銀估計約在 1.1% 至 2.5% 之間)，但由於目前利率仍低於此範圍的下限，日銀有必要持續調升利率，為貨幣政策正常化奠定基礎。
未來，日銀稱將持續密切監控中東局勢、人工智慧 (AI) 需求及匯率變動對日本經濟的影響。
paras_en: According to the summary of the Bank of Japan’s July policy meeting, internal concern about rising inflation risk has increased markedly. One board member noted that, given the core consumer price index (CPI) is close to the 2% target and price‑upside risks are higher than before, the BOJ’s future rate‑hike pace could be faster than market expectations.
At the meeting, the BOJ kept its policy rate at 1% but clearly signaled that a further hike could come in September.

The BOJ member called for a firm resolve to prevent inflation from overshooting and advocated a more flexible approach, discussing the size of any hike in response to changes in the overseas financial environment rather than sticking to a preset rhythm. The policy focus has shifted from “lifting inflation to 2%” to “avoiding further upward deviation of inflation.”

The yen’s movement is a key driver of rate‑hike expectations. The yen fell to a 40‑year low against the dollar last month, heightening concerns about import‑driven inflation. Market participants have begun pricing in the possibility of an early hike; overnight swap markets show about a two‑thirds probability of a September hike and a 96% chance of a hike before October.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda also adopted a hawkish tone at the post‑meeting press conference, stressing that price outlooks carry significant upside risk. One member said that, although it is currently difficult to pinpoint the “neutral rate” (the rate that neither stimulates nor cools the economy, which the BOJ estimates at roughly 1.1%‑2.5%), the present rate is still below the lower bound of that range, so the BOJ needs to keep raising rates to lay the groundwork for monetary‑policy normalization.
Going forward, the BOJ said it will continue to closely monitor the impact of Middle‑East developments, artificial‑intelligence (AI) demand and exchange‑rate movements on the Japanese economy.

items.title: 罕見！美財長貝森特多管齊下力阻長債殖利率攀升 華爾街嗅到政策訊號
items.title_en: Rare Move! US Treasury Secretary Yellen Takes a Multi-Pronged Approach to Curb Long-Term Bond Yield Rise, Wall Street Picks Up Policy Signals
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，美國財長貝森特正打出一套罕見組合拳，試圖掐住長端美債殖利率繼續急升的趨勢。
過去一週，在 30 年期美債殖利率觸及 19 年高點、10 年期站上 4.6% 區間後，貝森特接連出招，被交易員解讀為「財政部對長端利率感到焦慮」的明確信號。
上月底，美國自 1998 年來首度聯手日本買入日元，表面撐匯市，實則堵住日本為籌美元護盤而拋售美債的缺口。貝森特還提示東京可動用聯儲 SRF 融資機制，降低變賣美債壓力。
第二步是發債指引「微整形」。在上週季度再融資聲明中，美國財政部將長天期附息債發行前瞻由「增加 (increases)」改為「調整 (changes)」，市場普遍視為替未來削減 20 年、30 年期供給留後門。
第三步是輿論戰。貝森特近日頻上電視、發社群，為聯準會 (Fed) 主席華許模糊的通膨溝通策略護航，緩解「政策不透明→期限溢價飆升」的惡性循環。
摩根資產管理投資組合經理 Priya Misra 指出，Fed 與財政部必然擔心長端水位，
Misra 說，「干預日元、力挺華許、暗示減長債供給，都是在告訴市場：他們看見了且不惜用盡工具」，但他指出，年赤字近 2 兆美元、通膨黏性未消，新債供給只增不減，財長影響力有天花板。
對白宮而言，壓低房貸與企業融資成本是直接政治任務。美國財政部發言人未回應置評，但市場已接收到訊號，貝森特不想重演「長債失控」劇本，哪怕只能買到幾十個基點的緩衝。
paras_en: According to the latest reports from abroad, US Treasury Secretary Yellen is playing a rare combination of cards in an attempt to curb the rising trend of long-term US bond yields.

In the past week, after the 30-year US bond yield touched a 19-year high and the 10-year yield rose to the 4.6% range, Yellen has taken a series of measures, which traders interpreted as a clear signal that the Treasury Department is concerned about long-term interest rates.

At the end of last month, the US and Japan jointly purchased yen for the first time since 1998, ostensibly to support the foreign exchange market, but in reality to block Japan's sale of US bonds to defend the dollar. Yellen also hinted that Tokyo could use the liquidity provision mechanism of the Bank of Japan's SRF to reduce the pressure of selling US bonds.

The second step is the 'micro-adjustment' of the debt issuance guidelines. In the quarterly refinancing statement last week, the US Treasury Department changed the outlook for long-term bond issuance from 'increases' to 'changes', which the market widely interpreted as a signal to reduce the supply of 20-year and 30-year bonds in the future.

The third step is the public relations campaign. Yellen has recently appeared on TV and social media to defend the Fed's Chairman Powell's ambiguous communication strategy on inflation, aiming to break the vicious cycle of 'policy opacity -> term premium explosion'.
Priya Misra, investment portfolio manager at Morgan Asset Management, pointed out that the Fed and the Treasury Department must be concerned about the long-term level.

Misra said, 'Intervening in the yen, supporting Powell, and hinting at reducing long-term bond supply, are all telling the market: they see it and are willing to use all tools.' However, he pointed out that with a budget deficit of nearly $2 trillion and sticky inflation, new bond supply only increases, and the Treasury Secretary's influence has a ceiling.

For the White House, lowering mortgage and corporate borrowing costs is a direct political task. The US Treasury Department spokesperson did not respond to a request for comment, but the market has already received the signal that Yellen does not want to repeat the 'long bond out of control' script, even if it's just a few dozen basis points of buffer.

items.title: 日企高層警告：日元貶值與匯率波動加劇進口成本壓力
items.title_en: Japanese Corporate Leaders Warn: Yen Depreciation and Exchange Rate Volatility Exacerbate Import Cost Pressure
paras: 日本企業界正對日元持續走弱及其劇烈波動表達日益強烈的擔憂，這也反映了上週促使美日兩國採取聯合干預行動以支撐匯率的背景。雖然出口商通常受益於日元貶值，但目前的匯率環境正對日本這個高度仰賴進口的經濟體造成沉重負擔。
今年 7 月，日元兌美元匯率一度觸及近 164 的 40 年低點，隨後引發干預使日元反彈約 5%。三菱電機 (Mitsubishi Electric) 財務長 Yoshihiro Shimazu 直言：「日元疲軟並不代表一切順遂。」
他指出，能源、原材料與食品成本的上漲正在壓抑國內需求，威脅日本緩步走出長達數十年通縮的進程。
日本貿易振興機構 (JETRO) 主席 Norihiko Ishiguro 也指出，由於日本企業幾乎所有原物料皆需進口，當匯率貶至特定水準時，成本增加將使出口商不再是贏家。
為應對挑戰，Uniqlo 母公司迅銷 (Fast Retailing) 預計將日本部分秋冬商品價格調漲約 4% 以抵消日元跌幅；無印良品 (Muji) 則試圖透過加強內部生產而非僅靠漲價來維持利潤。
此外，劇烈的匯率波動也干擾了跨國企業的獲利預測與投資決策。三井物產 (Mitsui & Co) 與三菱商事 (Mitsubishi Corp) 均強調，市場高度波動對經營造成極大影響，企業必須適時修正其匯率假設。
根據調查，雖然約兩成日企認為 120 至 124 日元是最理想的區間，但業界對此並不樂觀，認為在日本基本面未改善且貿易平衡未恢復的情況下，恐難再見到 120 至 130 的水準。
paras_en: Japanese corporate leaders are increasingly concerned about the yen's persistent weakness and sharp fluctuations, reflecting the background that led to the joint intervention by the US and Japan last week to support the exchange rate. Although exporters typically benefit from a weaker yen, the current exchange rate environment is putting a heavy burden on Japan's economy, which relies heavily on imports.

In July, the yen's exchange rate against the dollar briefly touched a 40-year low of nearly 164, prompting intervention that caused the yen to rebound by about 5%. Mitsubishi Electric's CFO Yoshihiro Shimazu said, 'A weak yen does not mean everything is going smoothly.'
He pointed out that rising energy, raw materials, and food costs are suppressing domestic demand, threatening Japan's slow recovery from decades-long deflation.

JETRO Chairman Norihiko Ishiguro also pointed out that since almost all of Japan's raw materials need to be imported, when the exchange rate falls to a certain level, increased costs will make exporters no longer the winners.

To cope with the challenges, Fast Retailing, the parent company of Uniqlo, plans to raise the prices of some of its Japanese autumn and winter products by about 4% to offset the yen's decline; Muji is trying to maintain its profits by strengthening its internal production rather than just raising prices.

In addition, the sharp fluctuations in the exchange rate are also disrupting multinational companies' profit forecasts and investment decisions. Mitsui & Co and Mitsubishi Corp both emphasized that market volatility has a huge impact on their operations, and companies must adjust their exchange rate assumptions in a timely manner.

According to a survey, although about 20% of Japanese companies believe that the ideal range is between 120 and 124 yen, the industry is not optimistic, believing that it will be difficult to see a level of 120 to 130 yen again, given that the underlying fundamentals in Japan have not improved and the trade balance has not been restored.

items.title: 日元只是暫時穩住 中期選舉後才是真正壓力測試
items.title_en: Yen Stabilizes Temporarily, Real Pressure Test to Come After Midterm Elections
paras: 美日聯手干預外匯市場後，日元近期暫時止跌回穩，但這場救市行動背後的目的，可能不只是穩定匯率。
前華爾街基金經理、宏觀分析師 Ed Dowd 認為，此次干預時點與美國中期選舉高度吻合，核心考量之一，是避免日元持續貶值迫使日本拋售逾 1 兆美元美債，進而推升美債殖利率，在政治敏感期引發金融市場與經濟動盪。
問題是，美日利差等結構性矛盾並未解決，一旦中期選舉落幕、政治護盤動力消退，日元能否守住目前水準，將成為下一階段市場焦點。
干預短期奏效 長期效果仍存疑
這波聯合干預已迅速反映在匯市。日元自 163.65 的低點回升至 159.09 附近，創下 2 月以來最大單週漲幅。美國財長貝森特（Scott Bessent）8 月 2 日也公開證實美日協調行動，並表明美方不會猶豫參與進一步的聯合干預。
不過，市場人士普遍認為，單靠外匯干預仍屬治標不治本。歷史經驗顯示，如果官方干預缺乏基本面政策配合，效果往往難以持久，且隨著干預次數增加，所需規模可能愈來愈大，邊際效果卻逐漸遞減。
Dowd 警告，如果日本政策沒有持續跟進，日元最終仍可能重新走弱，迫使當局採取規模更大、頻率更高的干預，而每一輪行動也會提高資產價格劇烈波動與流動性事件發生的風險。
救日元背後 更要防美債遭拋售
要理解這波干預的深層邏輯，關鍵在於日本持有大量美國國債。日本是美債最大境外持有國之一，持有規模超過 1 兆美元。當日元大幅貶值，日本當局為捍衛本幣，可能面臨動用外匯存底、出售美債的壓力，進而直接推升美債殖利率。
在美國財政赤字居高不下之際，美債殖利率若快速攀升，可能帶來更棘手的後果。因此，從這個角度來看，這次干預的直接導火線，更可能是日元貶值帶來的美債拋售風險，而非單純為日元護盤。
貝森特也援引亞洲金融危機經驗指出，日元極度疲弱可能產生外溢效應，因此與其等到危機爆發，不如提前採取行動。
路透報導，美國財政部在干預前已透過紐約聯準銀行通知多家銀行，要求隨時準備因應後續行動，也凸顯這次干預具有高度協調性。
FIMA 擴容 降低美債賣壓
此次行動另一項關鍵，在於貝森特明確支持擴大 FIMA（外國和國際貨幣當局）回購便利規模。
透過這項機制，日本等外國央行可以將持有的美國國債作為抵押，向聯準會取得美元流動性，不必直接把美債拋售至公開市場。
分析人士認為，這項安排等同透過美債換取美元，降低市場上的美債賣壓，進一步抑制殖利率上行壓力。
日元不能太弱 也不能升太快
干預也帶來另一項風險，那就是規模龐大的日元套利交易。
長期以來，低利率日元被大量用作融資貨幣，投資人借入日元後轉進高利率貨幣及資產。一旦日元快速升值，融資成本隨之攀升，可能迫使套利部位大規模平倉，進而衝擊全球股票、債券及其他風險性資產。
2024 年 8 月就是近期案例，當時日元短時間內升值約 10%，日本股市及全球風險資產隨即劇烈震盪。
這次干預已帶動日元升值約 5%，市場目前反應仍相對平穩，但後續走勢仍存在風險。
這也讓美日當局陷入兩難：既不能讓日元持續貶值，迫使日本出售美債；又不能讓日元升值太快，以免觸發套利交易連鎖平倉。
中期選舉後 真正考驗才開始
更大的問題在於，這次干預並未解決日元疲弱的結構性因素。日本長期維持超寬鬆貨幣政策，與聯準會之間存在明顯利差，這才是持續壓低日元的重要力量。
同時，日本公共債務占 GDP 比率高居全球前列，財政空間有限，也使日本央行推動政策正常化面臨諸多限制。如果日本央行無法持續升息、財政紀律又沒有明顯改善，日元最終仍可能重新面臨貶值壓力。
而真正的變數可能出現在美國中期選舉之後。若此次干預確實帶有維持選前市場穩定的政治考量，選舉結束後，推動美日聯手護盤的政治意願是否仍然存在，將成為關鍵。
屆時，若日本自身的結構性問題依舊未解，而這波干預帶來的效果逐漸消退，市場面對的壓力可能比現在更加嚴峻。
換言之，日元目前或許只是暫時穩住，真正的壓力測試，恐怕要等到中期選舉之後才會到來。
paras_en: After the US and Japan jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market, the yen has temporarily stabilized in recent times, but the purpose behind this rescue effort may not be just to stabilize the exchange rate.

Ed Dowd, a former Wall Street fund manager and macro analyst, believes that the timing of this intervention coincides with the US midterm elections, and one of the core considerations is to avoid a continuous depreciation of the yen forcing Japan to sell over $1 trillion in US debt, thereby pushing up US Treasury yields and causing financial market and economic turmoil in a politically sensitive period.

The problem is that the structural contradictions, such as the interest rate differential, have not been resolved, and once the midterm elections are over and the political protectionist momentum is lost, whether the yen can maintain its current level will become the next market focus.
The intervention has had a short-term effect, but its long-term effectiveness is still uncertain.

This joint intervention has quickly reflected in the market. The yen has risen from a low of 163.65 to around 159.09, creating a 2-month single-week gain. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent also publicly confirmed the US-Japan coordination action on August 2 and stated that the US will not hesitate to participate in further joint interventions.

However, market participants generally believe that relying solely on foreign exchange intervention is a palliative rather than a cure. Historical experience shows that if official intervention lacks basic policy support, the effect is often difficult to sustain, and as the number of interventions increases, the required scale may become larger, but the marginal effect will gradually decrease.

Dowd warned that if Japan's policies do not continue to follow up, the yen may eventually weaken again, forcing authorities to take larger-scale and more frequent interventions, and each round of action will increase the risk of asset price volatility and liquidity events.
The logic behind this rescue is not just to save the yen, but also to prevent US debt from being sold.

To understand the deeper logic of this intervention, the key lies in Japan's holding of a large amount of US debt. Japan is one of the largest foreign holders of US debt, with a holding size of over $1 trillion. When the yen depreciates sharply, the Japanese authorities may face pressure to use foreign exchange reserves and sell US debt, thereby directly pushing up US Treasury yields.

In a situation where the US fiscal deficit is high, if US Treasury yields rise rapidly, it may lead to more complicated consequences. Therefore, from this perspective, the direct trigger of this intervention is more likely to be the risk of US debt sales caused by yen depreciation, rather than simply protecting the yen.

Bessent also cited the experience of the Asian financial crisis, saying that a severely weak yen may have a spillover effect, so it's better to take action in advance rather than waiting for a crisis to break out.

Reuters reported that the US Treasury Department had notified several banks through the New York Federal Reserve before the intervention, asking them to be prepared for subsequent actions, highlighting the high degree of coordination of this intervention.
FIMA expansion reduces US debt selling pressure
Another key aspect of this action is that Bessent has explicitly supported the expansion of the FIMA (Foreign and International Monetary Authorities) repurchase facility.

Through this mechanism, foreign central banks, including Japan, can use US debt as collateral to obtain US dollars from the Federal Reserve, without having to sell US debt directly to the open market.

Analysts believe that this arrangement is equivalent to exchanging US debt for US dollars, reducing the selling pressure on US debt in the market, and further suppressing the upward pressure on yields.
The yen cannot be too weak, nor can it rise too quickly
The intervention also brings another risk, that is, the massive yen carry trade.

For a long time, the low-interest-rate yen has been used as a funding currency, and investors have borrowed yen to invest in high-yield currencies and assets. Once the yen rises rapidly, the financing cost will rise, and it may force the carry trade positions to be closed in large quantities, impacting global stocks, bonds, and other risk assets.
The case in August 2024 is a recent example, when the yen rose by about 10% in a short period, the Japanese stock market and global risk assets were severely shaken.
This intervention has driven the yen to rise by about 5%, and the market's current response is still relatively stable, but the subsequent trend still carries risks.

This has put the US and Japanese authorities in a dilemma: they cannot let the yen continue to depreciate, forcing Japan to sell US debt, and they also cannot let the yen rise too quickly, lest it trigger a chain of carry trade closures.
The real test will come after the midterm elections

The bigger problem is that this intervention has not solved the structural factors underlying the yen's weakness. Japan has maintained a long-term ultra-loose monetary policy, and there is a significant interest rate differential between Japan and the US, which is an important force in continuously depressing the yen.

At the same time, Japan's public debt-to-GDP ratio is high, and its fiscal space is limited, making it difficult for the Bank of Japan to promote policy normalization. If the Bank of Japan cannot continue to raise interest rates, and fiscal discipline has not improved, the yen may eventually face depreciation pressure again.

The real variable may come after the US midterm elections. If this intervention indeed has a political consideration to maintain market stability before the elections, whether the political will to push for joint protection after the elections will still exist will be a key factor.
At that time, if Japan's structural problems are still unresolved, and the effects of this intervention gradually wear off, the market may face even more severe pressure than it does now.
In other words, the yen may be stable temporarily, but the real pressure test may only come after the midterm elections.

美國勞工部公布，7 月非農就業人數減少 2.3 萬人，與路透調查經濟學家預期增加 8 萬人大相逕庭。美國失業率則降至 4.1%，但勞動參與率下滑至 61.4%，創近 5 年半低點。

paras_en: The US dollar softened against major currencies on Friday as the US non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased in July, sparking concerns about the resilience of the US economy and weakening the case for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike, which in turn dragged down the dollar.

At the close of the New York market, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar's movement against six major currencies, fell 0.44% to around 99.50, marking a 0.31% decline for the week and its second consecutive weekly drop.

The US Labor Department reported that non-farm employment decreased by 23,000 in July, contrary to the expected increase of 80,000 predicted by Reuters' survey of economists. The US unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, but the labor participation rate slid to 61.4%, a near 5.5-year low.

Following the release of the employment report, the dollar depreciated 0.57% against the yen to 157.56 yen but still appreciated about 0.10% for the week. The dollar-yen exchange rate had hit a 13-week low after the US and Japanese authorities conducted a historic intervention the previous week.
The euro rose 0.39% against the dollar to $1.1568, marking a 0.41% gain for the week.

The dollar's weakness reflects a cooling of expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently sees a 56% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September, up from 45% the previous day.

Thierry Wizman, a global foreign exchange and interest rate strategist at Macquarie Group, said, 'I think nobody really expected the non-farm payroll to be negative, and nobody expected the June employment numbers to be revised downward significantly.'

He further explained, 'I tend to think the market has pushed back the timing of the Fed's rate hike from September to October or December. Whenever the data shows the US economy is weaker or the labor market is not as strong as previously thought, the market pushes back the potential timing of the rate hike.'

US Treasury yields plummeted after the employment report was released. The 2-year Treasury yield, which typically tracks Fed rate expectations, fell 4.2 basis points to 4.245%, while the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield dropped 2 basis points to 4.649%.

items.title_en: Yen Suddenly Surges Again! Is It Due to Cold Non-Farm Data or US-Japan Intervention?
paras: 美國 7 月非農就業數據意外轉為負成長，重挫聯準會 (Fed) 升息預期，帶動美元全面走弱，日元兌美元周五 (7 日) 盤中突然大漲。由於美日當局才在數日前聯手進場支撐日元，交易員也高度警戒官方可能再度干預匯市。
美元兌日元一度重挫 1.1% 至 156.68 日元，隨後跌幅略為收斂，最新報 157.16 日元，已明顯遠離 7 月觸及的 163.99 日元、40 年來高點。
目前尚不清楚日本當局是否再次進場干預。不過，分析師指出，美國就業數據遠遜預期，加上美債殖利率大幅下跌，已足以促使投資人拋售美元，因此這波日元升勢可能主要由基本面因素推動。
三菱日聯金融集團 (MUFG) 資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，非農就業數據低於預期的幅度非常大，觀察美國殖利率曲線短端的劇烈反應，美元下跌並不令人意外。由於非農就業出現負值相當罕見，這次數據對 Fed 升息預期造成明顯打擊，市場理應出現強烈反應，美元也可能面臨廣泛賣壓。
美國勞工統計局 (BLS) 周五公布，7 月非農就業人口意外減少 2.3 萬人，6 月增幅則由原先公布的 5.7 萬人下修至 2 萬人。《路透》調查的經濟學家原先預估，7 月就業人口將增加 8 萬人，預測區間介於增加 1 萬至 14 萬人。
就業數據公布後不久，日本財務大臣表示，東京與華府一直保持「密切溝通」，必要時將毫不猶豫地干預匯市，進一步加深交易員戒心。
日本與美國上周五才罕見採取協調行動，共同買進日元，以阻止日元持續貶值。隨著疲弱非農數據為日元提供基本面支撐，加上美日官員持續釋出干預警告，市場正密切關注日元是否延續反彈，以及官方是否再次出手。
paras_en: The US 7-month non-farm employment data unexpectedly turned negative, severely undercutting the Federal Reserve's (Fed) interest rate hike expectations, leading to a sharp decline in the US dollar, and a sudden surge in the yen against the US dollar on Friday (7).

The US dollar against the yen plummeted by 1.1% to 156.68 yen, before narrowing its decline, and was last reported at 157.16 yen, clearly far removed from the 163.99 yen, a 40-year high touched in July.

It remains unclear whether Japanese authorities have intervened again in the foreign exchange market. However, analysts point out that the US employment data fell far short of expectations, coupled with a sharp decline in US Treasury yields, which is enough to prompt investors to sell the US dollar, and thus the yen's surge may be driven primarily by fundamental factors.

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) senior foreign exchange analyst Lee Hardman stated that the non-farm employment data fell short of expectations by a very large margin, and observed a sharp reaction in the US short-term interest rate curve, making the decline in the US dollar not unexpected.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported on Friday that the non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased by 23,000 in July, and the June increase was revised downward to 20,000 from the originally reported 57,000. Reuters' survey of economists had previously estimated that the employment population would increase by 800,000 in July, with a prediction range of 100,000 to 1.4 million.

Shortly after the release of employment data, Japan's Finance Minister stated that Tokyo and Washington have maintained 'close communication', and would intervene in the foreign exchange market without hesitation if necessary, further deepening the caution among traders.

Japan and the US took a rare coordinated action last Friday, jointly buying the yen to block its continued depreciation. With weak non-farm data providing fundamental support for the yen, and US and Japanese officials continuing to issue warnings of intervention, the market is closely watching whether the yen will continue its rebound, and whether officials will intervene again.
